acceptance_criterion: A user with valid credentials is authenticated and a session is created that carries their role
test_name: returns the user and role on success, and records last-login

acceptance_criterion: An incorrect email or an incorrect password is rejected with the same message
test_name: gives the same message for a wrong email as for a wrong password

acceptance_criterion: A rejection caused by a deactivated account is distinguishable from a rejection caused by wrong credentials
test_name: distinguishes a deactivated account from bad credentials

acceptance_criterion: On a failed login attempt no session is created and no last-login timestamp is recorded
test_name: records no last-login timestamp on a failed attempt

acceptance_criterion: On successful login the last-login timestamp and the authenticated user are recorded
test_name: records the last-login timestamp on success

acceptance_criterion: Logging out ends the session; navigating back to a protected page afterwards does not display any event data
An Event Organiser's event list contains only events where that organiser is the recorded owner
test_name: scopes an Organiser's events list to events they own (AC1)

acceptance_criterion: An Event Coordinator's list contains all events in the system, regardless of which coordinator is assigned
test_name: gives a Coordinator every event, not filtered by assignment (AC2)

acceptance_criterion: Venue Staff see booking requests and confirmed bookings for their own venues
test_name: scopes Venue Staff's venue bookings to their own venues (AC3)

acceptance_criterion: Technical Support Staff see equipment requests and reservations
test_name: scopes Tech Support's equipment requests to what they handle (AC4)

acceptance_criterion: An Attendee sees only events with registration enabled that are open to them
test_name: scopes an Attendee's events list to open-for-registration only (AC5)

acceptance_criterion: Filtering is applied when the list is retrieved, so a request for an event outside the user's relationship returns no event data at all
test_name: resolves an Organiser's events scope to their own events
